events.title: Elon Musk Wanted Tesla to Take Over OpenAI, Romantic Partner Testifies in Court
events.body: Former OpenAI board member Shivon Zilis, who has four children with Musk, discussed their relationship and her view of the warring billionaires’ investing conflicts.
